newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke pressured by BOE's George - Conservative.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke pressured by BOE's George - Conservative.

text.p: John Townend, chairman of the Conservative backbench finance committee, said the interest rate rise showed Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke may have bowed to pressure from Bank of England Governor Eddie George.
"I think probably it is a response to pressure from Eddie George," he told the Press Association domestic news agency.
"And I think it is probably aimed at steadying the markets before the Budget," he added.
"It is a touch on the tiller and shows the Government, despite being in an election year, is still determined that keeping inflation low is the number one priority."
